C0588.title: Mengyu Aerospace Science Education Base (Hainan Wenchang) Co., Ltd. Price Fraud Case
C0588.summary: In 2024, the Wenchang Municipal Market Supervision Bureau investigated Mengyu Aerospace Science Education Base (Hainan Wenchang) Co., Ltd. for selling space launch viewing packages on the Douyin platform using price comparison methods, such as displaying "¥3999 ¥5999," without ever having sold at the higher comparison price or disclosing its basis, constituting price fraud. The company was fined 6
